name: Little Piece Vol.2
source:
Fujimino High School. It looks normal, but people with mysterious power sometimes appear. This is a comedic but a little bit serious story about these people....

[From [url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/9829]Himeya Shop[/url]]

Little Piece is a series of three games and each game is divided into two parts in itself called; Psi0nic L0vers and Cross x Street.
translation:
藤见野高中。这里看似普通，却偶尔会出现拥有神秘力量的人。这是一个关于他们的故事，风格诙谐，却也带有些许严肃气息……

[摘自[url=http://www.himeyashop.com/product_info.php/products_id/9829]Himeya Shop[/url]]

《Little Piece》系列共有三部作品，每一部又分为《Psi0nic L0vers》和《Cross x Street》两个部分。
